title: Bounded Halting with a Touch Limit
statement: For any extended program, input bit string, coin string, word width, time bound, output value, output bit string, and touch limit, if the program halts with that output within the given time bound while touching at most the given number of memory addresses, then it also halts with the same output within the same time bound while touching at most $3t$ addresses, where $t$ is the time bound.
hypotheses_covered: The program, input, coin string, word width, time bound, output value, output string, and touch limit are arbitrary
